label: Soil and sediment thickness (Pelletier)
summary: Modelled thickness of the permeable layers above bedrock - soil, regolith and sedimentary deposits - averaged across hillslopes and valley bottoms by area and topographic wetness index. Clipped at 60S; 0 to 50 m.
credit: Pelletier, J.D. et al. (2016). Global 1-km Gridded Thickness of Soil, Regolith, and Sedimentary Deposit Layers. ORNL DAAC, Oak Ridge, Tennessee, USA.
licence: NASA ORNL DAAC - free to use with citation
note: File 6 of the bundle: a weighted mosaic of the hillslope soil and the valley-bottom/lowland sediment grids. -1 in the source is nodata and is stored here as 255. The name carries `hotlink-ok` because Cloudflare's hotlink protection 403s image extensions from any Referer outside the zone -- which in a browser reads as a bare network failure, not as a 403.
